members.name: memberA
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the customer writing about?

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or purchase in the app that the customer did not make or does not recognise (even if they ask for a refund or cancellation)
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal the customer did not make or does not recognise
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: Any complaint about a direct debit: one the customer did not set up or does not recognise, or wants refunded or reversed
criteria.money_appeared_unexpectedly: Money appeared in the account that the customer did not put there
criteria.compromised_card: Card details or PIN may be compromised, someone else may be using the card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card is lost or stolen (and not yet found)
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone with the app is lost or stolen
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM swallowed / kept / took the card
criteria.change_pin: Wants to change or reset the card PIN
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked or forgotten, too many wrong PIN attempts
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode, locked out of the app, login problems
criteria.cancel_order: Wants to cancel an order or purchase made with a merchant
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase, or asks how refunds work
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: A refund the merchant promised has not appeared in the account
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Charged twice / duplicate transaction for the same purchase
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A small unexplained extra charge or fee on the statement (e.g. a stray £1 or $1) that the customer asks about
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was reverted, cancelled or returned to the account
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM dispensed less cash than requested, or cash was not received / no cash came out though the app shows the withdrawal
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card purchase abroad, charged too much because of the rate
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate or extra charge on a cash withdrawal in a foreign currency
criteria.order_or_get_physical_card: Ordering or getting a physical card, getting the first PIN for a new card
criteria.disposable_card_limits: How many disposable cards can be used / their limits
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an extra or additional card
criteria.card_arrival: The new card has not arrived yet
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery to a country, express delivery
criteria.found_card_reactivate: Found a card previously reported lost and wants to use or reactivate it
criteria.card_not_working: Card is not working or broken
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Virtual or disposable virtual card not working or rejected
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment at a shop or online was declined
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment, or a payment not described as a transfer, is still pending, has not gone through yet or is taking long
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, using the card in shops
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card in the app, making the card show up in the app
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Visa or Mastercard: which brand the bank issues, which cards the bank offers or carries, getting a Visa or a Mastercard, or whether the customer's Visa/Mastercard can be used with the service
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Anything about Apple Pay or Google Pay, including topping up with them and which currencies they accept
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, using the card at ATMs
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined, card not working at the ATM
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still pending, or a cash withdrawal is not yet reflected in the balance (the account still shows the money)
criteria.card_fees: Fees for getting a card, extra cards or express card delivery
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or did not go through
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted or returned
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up: the steps, which apps or methods can be used, topping up with a card, card top-up problems (not which card types or currencies are accepted)
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque, depositing money
criteria.pending_transfer: A bank transfer (explicitly a transfer) is still pending
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer or a transaction they made (not a merchant order), sent money to the wrong account
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The recipient has not received the money sent
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money, salary or payments into the account, including which currencies a salary can be received in
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_transfer: Balance not updated after a bank transfer into the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_deposit: Balance not updated after a cheque or cash deposit
criteria.transfer_into_account: Making a transfer into the account, using a credit card to transfer money
criteria.generic_card_declined: My card keeps getting declined (generic, possibly when topping up)
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Charged a fee, or unexpected extra fees, for card payments or purchases, including while abroad or buying from another country
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Charged a fee for an ATM cash withdrawal
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer, are transfers free
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up with a card
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.exchange_charge: General question about what currency exchange costs or whether there is an exchange fee (not a complaint about a specific exchange)
criteria.exchange_overcharged: Complains that a currency exchange they made (changing money from one currency to another) cost more than expected, was charged too much, or got a wrong rate
criteria.cash_withdrawal_rates: Asks about exchange rates or rates for getting cash or ATM withdrawals in a foreign currency or abroad
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, how rates are set
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies the bank supports, holds or exchanges, or which transfer types (e.g. SWIFT, SEPA) are supported
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Whether the bank accepts the customer's credit card or a card type (e.g. American Express, a US or foreign card) for adding money or topping up, the options for topping up with such a card, or which currencies a top-up can be in
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity, which ID documents
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification failed or not possible
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying source of funds, or asking the bank to find out where money in the account came from
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the top-up card, verification codes
criteria.transfer_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary, or a transfer to a particular beneficiary or account is refused as not allowed or not possible, or buying crypto / sending to a crypto exchange does not go through
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing name, address or personal details
